subject: Request for post-report coverage letter to cover SOC 2 period gap — SkylineOps
messages:
From: Maya Torres <maya.torres@skylineops.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@skylineops.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage confirmation needed — SOC 2 bridge letter request

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re doing well. As part of our procurement review for the enterprise contract, our security team needs a short coverage/bridge letter that confirms Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2024-09-30) covers the period up to the present, or alternatively, a letter that explicitly documents compensating controls and any significant control changes since the report end date. Our current deadline for vendor approval is 2026-11-10 — is that feasible?

Specifics requested by our team:
- A dated bridge/coverage letter referencing the original SOC 2 Type II report (date and auditor)
- Confirmation of no material control changes since report end date, or list of changes with mitigating controls
- Any interim audit activity / attestations since the report period (if available)
- Point of contact for any follow-up evidence or SOC artifacts (snapshots, config exports, retention policy screenshots)

If you prefer, you can send a draft and we’ll route to our security team for acceptance.

Thanks — look forward to getting this squared away.

Best,
Maya Torres
Director, Information Security
SkylineOps

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Team — forwarding request from SkylineOps (see below). They want a short bridge letter that covers the gap from our report end (2024-09-30) through present. Deadline is 2026-11-10, but they said draft would be fine. Can Marissa and Olga prepare a brief letter and attach the most recent SOC 2 PDF? Also flag any substantive control changes we should call out.

Questions:
- Marissa: do we have any interim attestations or auditor communications since 2024-09-30?
- Olga: can you pull the change log for auth/IAM and data retention since 2024-09-30 so we can cite compensating controls if needed?

If easier, I can send SkylineOps a two-paragraph interim statement and mark it as "subject to internal review" while you finalize.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage confirmation needed — SOC 2 bridge letter request

Rishi / Olga / Maya,

I pulled the SOC 2 Type II report we completed with Lumen Audit LLP (report issued 2024-10-20; period 2024-01-01 — 2024-09-30). No interim external attestation has been issued since.

Summary for the letter:
- Report: Lumen Audit LLP, SOC 2 Type II, period ended 2024-09-30, report dated 2024-10-20.
- Control changes since 2024-09-30: we rolled out short-lived service tokens for internal control plane (2025-03), introduced optional VPC peering for Private customers (2025-08) and completed our key rotation policy automation (2026-02). None of these are material with respect to the common criteria in the SOC 2 report; compensating controls are in place (token TTLs, automated rotation audit logs, documented change approvals).
- Evidence available on request: change-approval logs, key rotation runbooks, and sample audit log exports.

I’m attaching the SOC 2 PDF for SkylineOps to the draft we’ll send. I’ll produce a one-page bridge letter draft and share it as a docx. Olga — can you confirm the log exports we should reference and provide the last rotated-key timestamps?

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_report.pdf

I pulled the artifacts: key rotation events show the latest full rotation job ran 2026-02-14T03:22:00Z; change-approval log entries for the VPC peering feature include approvals and rollback tests from 2025-07 through 2025-09. Exported samples are in the secure drive link (shared below).

Subject: Bridge letter and supporting materials — Redwood SOC 2 coverage for SkylineOps

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the patience — attaching a concise bridge letter ("bridge_letter_draft_SkylineOps_20261120.docx") and the full SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_report.pdf).

Key points in the attached letter:
- References the SOC 2 Type II report performed by Lumen Audit LLP (report dated 2024-10-20) and the report period (2024-01-01 to 2024-09-30).
- Confirms there have been no material changes to Redwood’s control environment with respect to the Trust Services Criteria covered in the report; lists non-material changes and compensating controls (token TTLs, automated key rotation, VPC peering hardening).
- Offers a path for follow-up evidence: log extracts, configuration snapshots, and change approval records (links/attachments provided).

If SkylineOps requires any edits to the letter language (for procurement or legal), let us know and we can issue an amended letter promptly. Also happy to arrange a short call between your security team and Marissa/Olga next week.

Next steps:
1) Confirm receipt of attachments and whether the letter language is acceptable for procurement.
2) If accepted, we will provide signed PDF and an export bundle of referenced artifacts via secure link.

Best,
